title: The Pattern Store
summary: The imperial smiths kept their patterns in the Forgehall, shelf on shelf. Haldor wants to know how they cast what they cast. He thinks the Assay already knows.

steps.journal: Open two chests in the Cinderworks. The old Forgehall is its first floor, and the pattern store there holds two.

ready: Two chests of the Forgehall's patterns. Take them to Haldor at the Ashgate Forge.
done: Lamp patterns, forty to a shelf, each to hold one. Haldor wrapped them up again very carefully.
